observations.name: uninitialized_stack
observations.observation: The emitted B retains the stack read before replacing below-SP observations with environment input. Disassembly instructions 33 and 41-48 show the aligned and byte memory-read arms. The sole kernel sets allow_uninit_stack through bpf_allow_uninit_stack, which uses CAP_PERFMON; check_stack_slot_within_bounds permits reads across MAX_BPF_STACK under that policy.

The emitted B returns zero on the candidate scalar-NULL read arms, following existing X86_SIM_L_READ_RECOVERY_AT. Historical exit-stack and branch-hardening receipts describe these original recovered-NULL labels. The current stock module carries load-site recovery offsets and stock register fixups.
